create_ResultStat_instance: create a ResultStat instance with a batch key and optional TensorBoard log root directory
feed_ResultStat_batch: feed a batch dictionary with reward tensors into ResultStat to accumulate win and loss counts
reset_ResultStat_counters: reset the win and loss counters in ResultStat back to zero for a new epoch
log_ResultStat_winrate: log the current win rate to TensorBoard and return a formatted summary message for the given epoch
get_ResultStat_num_games: get the total number of games played by accessing the num_games property on ResultStat
